description.value:
The Amalj'aa are tall with a muscular physique, and have a very martial culture, worshipping the primal Ifrit.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Amalj'aa gain +2 Strength, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Dexterity.
  • Type: Amalj'aa are Humanoids with the amalj'aa subtype.
  • Size: Amalj'aa are Medium creatures.
  • Base Speed: Amalj'aa have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Amalj'aa start off with Common and Amalj'aa. Amalj'aa with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Celestial, Draconic, Galkan, Goblin, Lalafellan, Mithran, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Bond to the Land: Amalj'aa gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC when in desert areas.
  • Deathless Spirit: Amalj'aa gain resistance 5 against shadow damage, do not lose hit points when gaining a negative level, and gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against death effects, energy drain, negative energy, and necromancy spells.
  • Stability: Amalj'aa gain a +4 racial bonus to CMD when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Stalker: Amalj'aa gain a +2 bonus on Perception and Survival checks, treated as class skills.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Claws: Amalj'aa gain two claw attacks, dealing 1d4 damage. These are primary natural attacks.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Darkvision: Amalj'aa receive darkvision out to 60 feet.
